claims.statement: Allen and Gallagher fought at Foster Island, about 30 miles below St. Louis, on 17 August 1869; the fight lasted eleven rounds in twenty-six minutes and the headline says it was decided a draw, with Allen called the winner.
claims.excerpt: Allen the Winner, but the Fight Decided a Draw.

claims.statement: The paper says Tom Allen was twenty-nine years old in April 1869, so he was born about 1839 or 1840.
claims.excerpt: He was twenty-nine years of age im April last, and yet he has fought thirteen hard battles

claims.statement: Tom Allen came over from England in company with a fighter the paper names as Bill Goes, champion of England (name garbled in the scan).
claims.excerpt: Allen came over from England in company with Bill

claims.statement: Tom Allen had fought thirteen hard battles in England, beginning in 1861.

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Bill Ryall gave sparring exhibitions together in the large cities of the country, then stayed a long time in St. Louis and made many friends.

claims.statement: Tom Allen went to Cleveland, where he ran a business that was liberally patronized (the word for it is garbled in the scan).

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Bill Davis in forty rounds lasting forty minutes at Chouteau Island, midway between St. Louis and Alton.

claims.statement: Bill Ryall was Allen's second at the Davis fight, assisted by Tom Kelly.

claims.statement: At the Davis fight, Allen wanted to fight Gallagher in the same ring straight after, but his friends prevented it.
claims.excerpt: Allen wanted to fight Gallagher in the same ring, after having tramped around in the sand

claims.statement: At ringside at the Davis fight, Gallagher said he could lick any Englishman in Allen's corner.
claims.excerpt: he could lick any Englishman in Allen's corner.

claims.statement: On the boat back from the Davis fight, Allen and Gallagher made a match to fight within three months for $1,000 a side.
claims.excerpt: between Allen and Gallagher to fight within three

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat 'Wagner' (Morris Conner) in twelve rounds lasting twenty minutes, for twenty pounds a side, in 1861.
claims.excerpt: alias Morris Conner, whom he defcated in twelve rounds

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat 'White' in eight rounds lasting fifteen minutes, for five pounds a side, in 1861.
claims.excerpt: lie beat ‘*White’ in eight rounds and fifteen minutes, for five pounds a side

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Gould in thirty-one rounds lasting fifty-five minutes, for fifteen pounds a side, in 1862 (printed as 1962).
claims.excerpt: he best Gould in thirty-one rounds, fifty-five minutes for fifteen pounds a side

claims.statement: Tom Allen lost to 'Posh Price' after forty rounds in fifty-five minutes, for twenty pounds a side, in 1862.
